# Monty on the BEAM

> A module-for-module Elixir reimplementation of the Thousand Brains Project's
> Monty. A studio runs Monty's own experiment configs from a browser, and an MCP
> server answers questions about Monty's docs, roadmap and code.

Two ways in: the studio at `/` (browser or desktop app), and `POST /mcp` over
Streamable HTTP. A terminal has `mix monty.run` and `mix monty.bench`.

## Reference (exact specs and schemas)

- [MCP server](docs/mcp.md): every tool, its arguments and what it answers.
- [Features](docs/features.md): what works, each claim linked to its proof. Generated; do not edit.
- [Module map](docs/module-map.md): the one rule that maps Python `a/b.py::C` to an Elixir module.
- [Config compatibility](docs/config-compatibility.md): which Hydra features are implemented and how far parity goes.
- [From Monty](docs/from-monty.md): every copied path and glob, and the task that writes it.
- [Readiness](docs/readiness.md): which experiments run here, and what each missing piece unblocks.
- [Partial classes](docs/partial-classes.md) and [planned classes](docs/planned-classes.md): what is not ported yet.
- [Monty differences](docs/monty-differences.md): every deliberate difference, and what this port suspects upstream.

## Tutorials (learning)

- [Start](README.md): the quickstart compose file, then the first experiment.
- [A CAD part in a run](docs/cad.md): STEP part, memory, recognition.
- [A CAD part, click by click](docs/experiments/cad/README.md): the same walk-through with screenshots of every page it passes.
- [A dog recognised from its scans](docs/experiments/dogs/README.md): the Objaverse corpus, the memory a training run wrote, and the run's own judgement.
- [A connectome steering a run](docs/experiments/flyverse/README.md): a plugin's experiment, the policy that steps it, and the run's own record.

## How-to guides (specific tasks)

- [Run the container](docs/container.md): image, variables, volumes, what it reports.
- [Desktop app](docs/desktop.md): the window, the folder it writes to, signing.
- [Several nodes](docs/cluster.md): what a cluster shares and what each node owns.
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): calling a plugin across a node, and the rules that keep it safe.
- [Parallel and live](docs/parallel-and-live.md): parallel episodes, a run that never stops.
- [Develop](docs/developers.md): tests, gates, the loop when Monty moves.

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): one timestep, and where Python sits.
- [Simulator port](docs/simulator-port.md): the world on the other side of a port.
- [Theories](docs/theories.md): independent processes on theories.
- [Validation](docs/validation.md): what has been compared with Monty's numbers.
